## About
California Hi-Tech Plumbing is a family-owned business on Wilshire Blvd in Beverly Hills. We do all plumbing: residential, commercial repair, service and new construction, for neighbors from Santa Monica and Malibu to Burbank, Pasadena and Chatsworth.
We don't take shortcuts. Every job is done thoroughly and by code, with high-quality parts that are designed to last. Before we start, we make sure you're comfortable and understand the work that will be done.
Our customers have given us a 5 rating from 29 Google reviews, and reviewers mention Ilan by name.

## Services
- Hydro Jetting: A thorough way to unclog drains and keep them clear.
- Water Heater Repair & Installation: Tank and tankless water heaters, for homes and businesses.
- Emergency Services: When something goes wrong, we have the knowledge and equipment to find it and fix it fast.
- Drain Cleaning: Professional drain equipment to clear blockages and get your drain working normally again.
- Sewer Line Repair & Replacement: Troubleshooting and repair for complicated sewer line problems.
- Water Leak Detection: We track down the source of the leak before it does more damage.
- Pipe Bursting: A trenchless way to repair your sewer line and restore service with less digging.
- Gas Line Repair & Installation: Gas lines for stoves, heaters, fireplaces and other gas appliances.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. We offer free estimates, so you know where you stand before any work starts.

Q: Do you work on homes and businesses?
A: Both. We handle residential and commercial repair, service and new construction.

Q: Which areas do you serve?
A: Beverly Hills, Sherman Oaks, Brentwood, Studio City, Culver City, Santa Monica, Malibu, Miracle Mile, Pasadena, Marina Del Rey, Burbank, Calabasas, Westlake and Chatsworth.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Wednesday and Friday through Sunday, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Thursday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
